# atproto_tangled_repository (Resource)

Creates a git repository on a knot and the `sh.tangled.repo` record that announces it.

~> Destroying this resource, or changing `name`, `knot`, or `source`, deletes the repository and its history from the knot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atproto_tangled_repository" "site" {
  name        = "site"
  knot        = "knot.example.com"
  description = "My website"
  topics      = ["web"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `knot` (String) Domain of the knot that hosts the repository. The account must be a member of it.
- `name` (String) Repository name.

### Optional

- `created_at` (String) Record creation time. Defaults to the time the record is created.
- `default_branch` (String) Default branch. Defaults to the knot's default, usually `main`.
- `description` (String) Short description, up to 140 characters.
- `labels` (List of String) AT URIs of the label definitions the repository subscribes to.
- `source` (String) URL of a repository to clone from when creating this one.
- `spindle` (String) Spindle that runs CI for the repository.
- `topics` (List of String) Up to 50 topics.
- `website` (String) URI related to the repository.

### Read-Only

- `cid` (String) CID of the current version of the record.
- `id` (String) AT URI of the record.
- `repo_did` (String) DID the knot assigned to the repository.
- `rkey` (String) Record key, the lowercased name without a `.git` suffix.
- `uri` (String) AT URI of the record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The record key, which is the lowercased repository name.
tofu import atproto_tangled_repository.site site
```
